claims.text: The source defines the style-based generator: 8-layer MLP maps z to intermediate space W; learned affine styles drive per-layer AdaIN from a learned 4x4x512 constant plus per-layer Gaussian noise; mixing regularisation crosses two latents at a random point.
claims.context: Correct body style-generator/mixing sections; title/authors verified.

claims.text: Reported numbers: FID 50k 1024px FFHQ config-f 4.40 and CelebA-HQ 5.17 vs baseline-a 8.04; path-length FFHQ traditional-Z 412.0/415.3 vs style-W with noise 200.5/160.6; linear separability 10.78 vs 3.54.
